hero.subheadline: Expert Ecuadorian teachers, personalised lessons, flexible scheduling. Join from anywhere in the world.

why.subtitle: More than an app. More than a freelance teacher.
why.lede: Here's what makes learning with Vida Verde different.

school.title: A Real School, Not a Platform
school.description: Vida Verde has been teaching Spanish since 1999. AECEE-certified, structured, and accountable. Not a marketplace of strangers.

teachers.title: Expert Native Teachers
teachers.description: Every teacher is a university-trained Ecuadorian native speaker with years of classroom experience. Not a hobbyist. Not a part-timer.

learning.title: Personalised to You
learning.description: No fixed syllabus. Your teacher adapts every lesson to your level, goals, and pace. Whether you're a complete beginner or polishing your fluency.

flexibility.title: Learn Anywhere
flexibility.description: Classes via Google Meet. Real conversation, real feedback, real progress. From your living room, office, or café.

programs.title: Find Your Perfect Spanish Program
programs.lede: Whether you're at home or heading to Ecuador. We have a programme for you.

online.label: Online Classes
online.description: One-on-one lessons with a native teacher via Google Meet. Flexible scheduling, all levels. Start today.

quito.label: Study in Quito
quito.description: Full immersion in Ecuador: daily classes, homestay with an Ecuadorian family, and cultural activities.

travel.label: Travel Spanish
travel.description: Travelling to Ecuador? Learn the Spanish you'll actually use before or during your trip.

guide.label: Free Spanish Guide
guide.description: Not sure where to start? Download our free guide and take your first steps. No commitment needed.

testimonials.title: Real Students. Real Results.
testimonials.lede: Over 4,700 students from around the world have learned Spanish with Vida Verde. Here's what some of them say.

teachers.title: Your Teacher Is Waiting
teachers.lede: Choose your teacher and book your first lesson today. All our teachers are Ecuadorian native speakers with university-level training.

descriptions.ximena: Students say class hours with Ximena pass by in a flash. She has been teaching Spanish since 2011 and is fluent in English, making her especially effective with beginners.
descriptions.lucia: Lucía is a language nerd who loves to teach the nuts and bolts of Spanish. She excels at helping students understand grammar intuitively and speaks at a clear, easy-to-follow pace.
descriptions.fernando: Fernando is our Academic Director and master teacher. He brings structure, warmth, and deep expertise to every lesson. Students consistently rate him as the most effective teacher they have had.
descriptions.laura: Laura has taught Spanish since 1991. She has a passion for sharing Ecuadorian culture with her students and considers herself not just a teacher but an ambassador of her culture and her language.

aboutSchool.title: Teaching Spanish Since 1999
aboutSchool.paragraph1: Vida Verde was founded in 1999 by Rosa, a Spanish teacher with a simple belief: the best way to learn a language is through a real human connection.
aboutSchool.paragraph2: From our home in La Floresta. One of Quito's most vibrant and welcoming neighbourhoods. We've grown to serve over 4,700 students from every corner of the world. Online and in person. Beginners and advanced speakers. Travellers and professionals.
aboutSchool.paragraph3: We're proud to hold AECEE certification, a quality standard recognised across the Spanish-speaking world.
